title: popover_demolish_hit fire-path unscripted — the shared proc's new pipe leg is unreachable in the harness
detail: The UI hook is wired only for input_parity_esc_ui, which never selects a pipe, so the shared proc's new PIPE leg and both positive button-hit→demolish paths (node and pipe) are unscripted; a drift in the shared hit-test fires no harness failure.
recommended_fix: Add a harness scenario that selects a pipe and presses its demolish button through parity_ui_press_effect, asserting demolish_pipe fires and the press is swallowed, exercising the shared proc's positive legs.
